glossEn: motor that converts thermal energy to mechanical work
note: motor that converts thermal energy to mechanical work。线索：a car engine / engine failure / search engine。

glossEn: something used to achieve a purpose
note: something used to achieve a purpose。比喻义，实际英语中最常用的一条。线索：the engine of growth / a marketing engine。现有中文无对应，属新增。
[glossEn 空：ECDICT 与 WordNet 均无对应义位] [ZH-FALLBACK 英文零覆盖] 英文 railway / steam engine。WordNet 无此边界，走 fromZh 补洞，glossEn 留空。指机车本身时英文更常用 locomotive。

glossEn: an instrument or machine that is used in warfare, such as a battering ram, catapult, artillery piece, etc.
note: an instrument or machine that is used in warfare。罕见。现有中文无对应，属新增。造句须带 war/military 语境。
